_comment: Services the owner offers. keywords are regexes matched on the lowercase customer message. items point at ids in prices.json. 'group' items are alternatives: the one whose 'when' matches is used; if none matches, all are shown as options and left out of the total.

services.name: ATS (automatic transfer switch)
questions: What amperage do you need (100A or higher)?

services.name: Contactors and components
questions: What is the rating (amps) and coil voltage, or can you send a photo of the old one?

services.name: Pump or motor rewinding
questions: What is the pump or motor rating (HP or kW) and brand?
Can you send a photo, or bring the machine for inspection?

services.name: Solar installation
questions: Is it for a home or a business?
What do you want to power (lights, fridge, AC)?

services.name: CCTV
questions: How many cameras do you need?

services.name: Burnt or damaged wiring
questions: Which room or area is affected?
Can you send a photo, only if it is safe?

services.name: Switch or socket fault
questions: Which switch or socket is it?
What is happening (no power, tripping, hot)?

services.name: House wiring
questions: How many bedrooms, and is it new wiring or a rewire?

services.name: Urgent equipment repair
questions: What equipment is it and what is it doing?
Can you bring it in, or must we come to you?
